Exploitability_explanation: Vulnerable API EmailStr/validate_email is not used in the codebase. Pydantic is used only for Schemas and Settings.
ComfyUI uses aiohttp.ClientSession for various tasks (e.g., in comfy_api_nodes). auto_decompress is enabled by default, making it vulnerable to Zip Bombs if connecting to untrusted servers.
ComfyUI server uses request.post() in server.py (e.g., for image uploads). This is vulnerable to an infinite loop if the server is run with Python optimizations enabled.
ComfyUI server uses request.post() which is susceptible to DoS via malicious multipart/form-data payloads.
Vulnerable API DonutProcessor.token2json() is not used in the codebase.
ComfyUI server uses request.post() for file uploads. Without strict body size limits at the application layer, it is vulnerable to memory exhaustion.
Vulnerability requires the pure Python HTTP parser. ComfyUI typically runs in environments where C extensions are available, making exploitation unlikely (Internal Usage Only rule).
Vulnerability requires the pure Python HTTP parser. High probability is only assigned if pure Python mode is confirmed.

Vulnerable API MarianTokenizer.remove_language_code() is not used in the codebase.
ComfyMathExpression node uses simpleeval to evaluate user-provided expressions. Pre-1.0.5 versions have a sandbox escape and the expression input is untrusted.
Vulnerability is in transformers-cli chat command, which is not used by ComfyUI.
Core aiohttp vulnerability affecting Host header validation. Reachable via the main ComfyUI server.
ComfyUI uses web.static() extensively on Windows. Misconfigured or malicious custom node paths could lead to NTLMv2 hash leaks via UNC paths.
Core aiohttp vulnerability in chunked message processing, leading to CPU exhaustion. Reachable via server.py.
Core aiohttp vulnerability in header/trailer processing, leading to memory exhaustion.
Aiohttp client (used in comfy_api_nodes) is vulnerable to DoS from malicious multipart responses.

ReDoS in configuration file parsing. Low probability as it requires loading models from untrusted local/remote sources.
